title: Kissed with Sesame Mexican Chicken Tinga
description: Fatty, velvety Mexican dish featuring sesame butter and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a solo dinner.

ingredients.name: Sesame butter
ingredients.notes: Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly alternative to traditional butter.

ingredients.name: Chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
ingredients.notes: Look for brand without added sugars.

ingredients.name: Pita or Mexican street food tortillas
Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly Mexican crema (or Greek yogurt

instructions: Place the chicken breasts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the chicken breasts in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken breasts using two forks into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the sesame butter.
Add the chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, cumin powder, chili powder, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the melted sesame butter.
Stir to combine and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the shredded chicken to the saucepan and stir to combine with the chipotle sesame butter mixture.
Add the lime juice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the liquid has thickened slightly.
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Warm the pita or Mexican street food tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.

Assemble the Kissed with Sesame Mexican Chicken Tinga by spooning the chicken mixture onto a warmed tortilla and topping with crushed tortilla chips, sour cream, avocado or guacamole, and sliced radishes.
